defaultPrompt: Forensically audit this system and design evidence-backed improvements.
interface.longDescription: A.S.F.R.E.E is a modular, evidence-driven orchestrator for authorized AI and software forensics, evaluation, diagnosis, comparison, supervised remediation and reconstruction. M00 coordinates O01–O12, while Security & Governance and Evaluation Intelligence operate as cross-cutting control planes. It defaults to read-only analysis, uses explicit authority and capability gates, and distinguishes evidence, inference, hypotheses, tests and verified outcomes. This package contains portable skill instructions and data contracts; it does not itself deploy scanners, runtimes, databases, API gateways or MCP servers.

name: asfree
description: A unified, evidence-driven forensic intelligence and supervised engineering orchestrator for authorized AI systems and software.
